hero.heading: Pallet & Material Handling Solutions
hero.body: Designed to match your operational needs — not generic assumptions.

productBlocks.heading: Stock Pallets
productBlocks.tagline: Reliable, high-volume supply sourced through trusted manufacturers to meet recurring demand without unnecessary customization or delay.
productBlocks.body: Our stock pallets are designed for businesses that value consistency, speed, and cost efficiency. With standardized dimensions and proven load performance, they’re ideal for warehousing, retail distribution, logistics, and export operations. Every pallet is produced under strict quality controls to ensure durability, structural integrity, and dependable performance across multiple handling cycles.
productBlocks.alt: Stacked wood pallets against a blue sky.

productBlocks.heading: Engineered Pallet Solutions
productBlocks.tagline: Using Pallet Design System (PDS) methodology, AGL designs pallets precisely tailored to your load requirements, weight capacities, and operational conditions — without overbuilding or overspending.
productBlocks.body: Every supply chain has unique demands. From dynamic loads in transit to static warehouse storage and racking systems, engineered pallets ensure optimal performance under real-world conditions. Through detailed analysis of product weight, stacking patterns, handling methods, and environmental factors, we develop pallet specifications that maximize strength while minimizing unnecessary material usage.
productBlocks.alt: A forklift loading wood pallets onto a flatbed trailer.

productBlocks.heading: Crates & Dunnage
productBlocks.tagline: Custom and stock crate solutions designed for secure transport and specialized shipping needs.
productBlocks.body: When products require added protection beyond standard palletization, our crates and dunnage systems provide the structural support and containment necessary for safe transit. Whether shipping heavy equipment, sensitive components, or high-value goods, we deliver solutions engineered to minimize movement, absorb impact, and withstand demanding logistics conditions.
productBlocks.alt: A log loader machine lifting logs at an outdoor lumber yard.

productBlocks.heading: Shipping Blocks
productBlocks.tagline: Supplemental material handling components designed to enhance stability and support palletized and specialized loads.
productBlocks.body: Shipping blocks play a critical role in reinforcing load integrity during storage, handling, and transport. Whether used to elevate products, create spacing for forklift access, stabilize irregular items, or distribute weight more evenly, these components improve safety and reduce the risk of damage throughout the supply chain.
productBlocks.alt: Stacked wood pallets against a blue sky.

ctaBand.heading: Let’s Talk About Your Pallet Needs
ctaBand.body: Whether you’re sourcing pallets daily or planning for upcoming demand, AGL Pallet is ready to support your operation.
